items.statement: Investigate what can be established at the molecular level about the different oxidation behavior of the supplied para-substituted benzyl alcohols. Develop and test an explanation for the comparatively poor conversion of the methylsulfanyl alcohol toward its aldehyde under the reported flavin-mediated electrophotochemical conditions. Determine which parts of that explanation your evidence supports, which remain unresolved, and whether the molecular evidence is sufficient to explain the observation.
items.expected: Conclude what the investigation establishes about the SMe oxidation contrast and what it cannot distinguish. Trace every main statement to valid findings and their scope. Full credit is possible for an evidence-supported alternative, refutation or bounded unresolved answer, without matching the sulfur/BDE interpretation. No full scientific credit for a copied source scalar, absent calculations labeled ambiguity, or molecular descriptors promoted to catalytic rate/yield/full-network proof. Partial claims earn only their supported coverage; honest execution failure is not fabrication.
